rows.grounds: compound of ṣaṭ, tala, and anta; neuter plural adjective
gopurāṇi plus api with sandhi i to y before a

items.question: What architectural feature do the middle gopuras also possess?
items.inference: The middle gopuras also end in six talas.
uncertainties: Exact referent of madhyānāṃ remains unclear.
items.plain_english: The middle gopuras also have six-tala ends.
